definitions.layerRollups: Company-wide financials of tracked companies classified once by canonical primary AI Stack layer; not AI-segment totals.
definitions.ttmCapex: Previous fiscal-year capex plus current-period YTD capex minus prior-year comparable YTD capex; a current FY uses the algebraically equivalent FY boundary.
definitions.ttmResearchAndDevelopment: Four compatible standalone fiscal quarters ending at each company's last report within the common comparison window.
definitions.ttmRevenue: Four compatible standalone fiscal quarters ending at each company's last report within the common comparison window.
